buildCommand:
set -eu; [ "${VERCEL:-}" = "1" ] || { echo '[BLOCKED] vercel-context'; exit 1; }; [ "${VERCEL_ENV:-}" = "production" ] || { echo '[BLOCKED] vercel-environment'; exit 1; }; [ "${VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_REF:-}" = "main" ] || { echo '[BLOCKED] git-ref'; exit 1; }; set +e; pre=$(npm run verify:integration-settings-migration 2>&1); pre_rc=$?; set -e; printf '%s
' "$pre"; [ $pre_rc -eq 0 ] || exit 1; if printf '%s
' "$pre" | grep -q 'MIGRATION STATUS: FULLY_APPLIED'; then echo 'MIGRATION EXECUTION: SKIPPED_ALREADY_APPLIED'; elif printf '%s
' "$pre" | grep -q 'MIGRATION STATUS: NOT_APPLIED' && ! printf '%s
' "$pre" | grep -Eq '\[(BLOCKED|UNKNOWN)\]|PARTIALLY_APPLIED|Duplicate provider/key groups|conflicting index|CONFLICT'; then npm run migrate:integration-settings; echo 'MIGRATION EXECUTION: APPLIED_ONCE'; else echo '[BLOCKED] unsafe-pre-migration-status'; exit 1; fi; post=$(npm run verify:integration-settings-migration 2>&1); printf '%s
' "$post"; printf '%s
' "$post" | grep -q 'MIGRATION STATUS: FULLY_APPLIED' || { echo '[BLOCKED] post-migration-not-fully-applied'; exit 1; }; ! printf '%s
' "$post" | grep -Eq '\[(WARNING|BLOCKED|UNKNOWN)\]|PARTIALLY_APPLIED' || { echo '[BLOCKED] post-migration-warning'; exit 1; }; flight=$(npm run preflight:integration-settings 2>&1); printf '%s
' "$flight"; printf '%s
' "$flight" | grep -q 'INTEGRATION SETTINGS PREFLIGHT: PASS' || { echo '[BLOCKED] preflight-failed'; exit 1; }; ! printf '%s
' "$flight" | grep -Eq '\[(WARNING|BLOCKED|UNKNOWN)\]' || { echo '[BLOCKED] preflight-warning'; exit 1; }; npm run build
